rules.quote: Be a citizen of a Chevening-eligible country or territory.
Have at least two years’ work experience, acquired after completing your undergraduate degree, equivalent to 2,800 hours.

rules.value: UG degree finished at least two years before deadline
rules.quote: You must have finished your undergraduate studies at least two years before our application deadline
Commit to returning to your home country (country of award) for at least two years after your scholarship ends.

rules.value: apply to three UK courses; one unconditional offer
rules.quote: Apply to three different and eligible UK university courses.

rules.value: UK government / British Council / partner university employees and relatives
rules.quote: Are an employee, an immediate relative* of an employee, or a former employee (within the last two years, from the opening of Chevening applications) of a government department, the British Council, a partner UK university
you must have completed your undergraduate degree by October 2024 to be eligible to apply.
